podcast.title: Casting as Dan Conner in Roseanne
podcast.body: Barr told Entertainment Weekly in 2008 that Goodman was the only person who read for the role of Dan Conner in Roseanne, despite more readings being planned. She "fell in love with him" the moment she met him. He had previously gained attention on Broadway. "He said, there were more planned, but the second I met that guy, I fell in love with him."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Lack of Acting Cred
xref.body: Despite her success as a comedian, she had no prior acting experience, which the production team considered a challenge and felt it was imperative to pair her with a skilled actor like John Goodman. "There was a comedian. She had no acting cred."
